summary: City marina page refuses (403, unread); the city's 2026 fee-schedule PDF read: transient water/electric $40/day tax incl., weekly $36/day, monthly $550, and a $1,790 seasonal campground rate. Nightly share NOT measurable from what could be read; imagery shows two rows of ~30 parked units. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin ~165 m east of the camping lot. Google (shared with the boat marina) 4.6/100.
flags: LONG-STAY UNMEASURED: the city sells seasonal campground sites ($1,790 a season, plus winter camper storage) alongside $40 transient nights. The marina page that would give the split refuses (403); directories (Campendium, Good Sam, rvpoints) give 36 sites but no split. Esri imagery shows the camping lot with two rows of ~15 parked units each.
